scope.selection: existing changed files in git diff base..source

record_coverage.interpretation: Records include deliberately repeated conditions and 6 copied nominal records. Distinct raw directory identities are not independent random trials. No pooled success rate is inferred.

complete_C_denominators.cross_backend_note: 546d H32-u1 has Warp 9/20 pull and 9/20 push; native 3.3 has 9/20 pull and 10/20 push. The one additional native push pass is C08.

targeted_subsets.interpretation: Subset denominators are the tested cases only. Tail C08 1/1 and planar arm 2/6,3/6 do not establish a full 20-case C result.

final_546d_H32_contact_regression.basis: Every changed result.json has segment=full; no new final 546d H32 ten-contact-task result set was found. This does not invalidate older anchors, but they cannot be relabeled as the new checkpoint.

tmux_final_recovery.interpretation: This is the final committed 21:11:04 Beijing snapshot, not a fresh remote process inspection; it supersedes the earlier running descriptions.

video_review.decode_method: ffmpeg full decode to null output; all 102 complete; no stream error reported
video_review.sampling: first, middle, last frame per video; all 5 contact sheets actually viewed

contact_sheets.note: Temporary derived contact sheets are excluded from the repository. The original committed video paths and sampled frame indices below are the persistent evidence references.

observations: Same 546d H32-u1 nominal pull/push clips across Warp, CPU 3.16 and native 3.3 show opening and arm return in sampled frames.
Several u10 failures visibly stop with a closed door or before arm return; phase-TD u10 pull has opened but stops during retreat_arm.
Stance-u5 pull visually opens and stows; its 11.59 mm terminal station miss is established by raw numerical readiness, not by low-resolution frames.
Tail push C08 and its nominal pair visually agree with opening/return; their quantitative continuous success evidence remains the raw result events.
limitations: Full decode is not frame-by-frame visual review.
Three-frame sampling cannot certify absence of transient force violations, all timing conditions, or full contact history.
No claim is made that unrecorded targeted C subsets were visually reviewed.
The 102 files include copied nominal videos; file count is not independent trial count.

remaining_gates: A single frozen candidate does not yet achieve at least 18/20 on both full C directions.
Final 546d H32 checkpoint still needs its own ten contact-task regression evidence.
Further H32 updates regress nominal behavior; u5/u10 stability and independent multi-seed evidence remain open.
Learned terminal/contact prediction fails its held-out diagnostic criteria and is not accepted.
Held-out H and independent final acceptance should remain untouched until development gates are met.

failure_model.interpretation: Calibration FPR met 1%, validation FPR did not; the event head was not accepted for deployment.

perturbation_teacher.interpretation: P6 completion and same-phase labels do not imply task-valid trajectories under the unchanged full reference/event judge.

fixed_endpoint_geometry.interpretation: This is a local frozen-angle endpoint collision check. It does not prove global task infeasibility and did not search for a legal path that first moves the passive door.

review_provenance.visual_review_attribution: Team review: recovery_evidence_audit agent inspected 30 unique video files at first, middle and last frames, for 90 inspected frames in total.

standard_transfer.necessary_wrapper: fixed home/effort/gain servo-unit mapping and consistent clipping
standard_transfer.best_established_stage: B0-03 free motion; standard contact and full-task transfer not passed

reference_residual_540.interpretation: Five sequential training stages with different data/purposes, not one matched 15000-step experiment; official latent encoder bc_loss is not this action-supervision training.

analytic_stance_546.interpretation: Same-checkpoint three-backend nominal success is mixed-policy evidence and does not fill standard-transfer acceptance.

method_identity_audit.provenance_limit: Repository configs, update logs, code and case results were inspected; remote large checkpoints were not reloaded during this review.
